headlineOfDay: An AI-led tech rout pushed the S&P 500 and Dow into correction and wiped out the Nasdaq's 2026 gains, as Anthropic's IPO and Nvidia sank.

markets.summary: US stocks fell sharply, with the S&P 500 down 3.7% and the Nasdaq down 5.3%, taking the S&P 500 and Dow into correction territory. Chip and AI names led the losses, with Nvidia down 14% and Micron and AMD also hit hard. European markets also fell, with the Euro Stoxx 50 down 2.8% and the FTSE 100 down 1.0%, while gold and silver sold off heavily.

commodities.label: Brent crude
commodities.note: Brent is on course for a weekly drop of about 5% as recovering Gulf flows outweigh tanker attacks.

commodities.label: US natural gas
commodities.note: Colder weather and an early polar vortex breakdown are threatening already low European gas stocks.

losers.name: Nvidia
losers.note: Nvidia extended its longest weekly losing streak since 2008 and faces an SEC accounting probe after Jensen Huang's resignation.

losers.name: Micron Technology
losers.note: Memory stocks fell in the wider chip rout.
